capabilities.name: COGO points, Delaunay TIN surface, and cut/fill volumes
capabilities.reference_behavior: 3D COGO points form a Delaunay TIN surface. The implemented subset evaluates barycentric elevation interpolation, triangle contours, and a datum-based planar-triangle cut/fill estimate.
capabilities.expected_input: 3 survey points forming triangle, datum elevation 8.0 m
capabilities.expected_output: Interpolated elevation 8.0 m; cut volume 100 m3, fill volume 0 m3
capabilities.differences: No breaklines, boundaries, point groups, surface edits, or contour stitching. Volume calculation does not split a triangle where the datum crosses its face.

capabilities.name: Horizontal alignment stationing and station/offset projection
capabilities.reference_behavior: The implemented tangent/curve alignment calculates cumulative engineering stationing (STA 00+00.00); tangent entities support coordinate projection to station and perpendicular signed offset.
capabilities.differences: Station equations, clothoid spirals, constraint-based layout, curve station/offset projection, superelevation, and labels are absent.

capabilities.name: Vertical profile PVI grade calculation and LandXML 1.2 interoperability
capabilities.reference_behavior: Profile PVI station/elevation evaluation along an alignment and LandXML 1.2 export of the implemented CgPoint, surface, alignment, and profile subset.
capabilities.expected_output: Elevation 120.0 m at STA 400; valid LandXML 1.2 XML document
capabilities.differences: No LandXML import, schema-wide conformance claim, graphical profile editor, corridors, assemblies, grading, parcels, or pipe networks.

capabilities.name: Persistent civil project browser, plan viewport, properties, history, and files
capabilities.reference_behavior: A standalone civil workspace creates and selects domain objects, edits COGO and project properties, visualizes TIN/contour/alignment geometry, and preserves work through undo, save, reopen, and LandXML export.
capabilities.expected_input: Five survey points, one TIN, one alignment, one profile, COGO elevation edit
capabilities.expected_output: Selectable civil hierarchy and plan geometry; edited state survives redo and native reopen; exported XML contains surface, alignment, and profile definitions
capabilities.performance: CPU plan viewport intended for the currently tested small project subset.
capabilities.differences: No profile view, section editor, corridor model, survey database, production labeling, sheet generation, or GPU large-surface renderer.
